records.eventLabel: winter pentathlon at the 1948 Winter Olympics
records.text: On January 31, 1948, winter pentathlon at the 1948 Winter Olympics began in St. Moritz.
records.textJa: 1948年1月31日、winter pentathlon at the 1948 Winter Olympicsが始まった（St. Moritz）。

records.eventLabel: winter pentathlon at the 1948 Winter Olympics
records.text: On February 4, 1948, winter pentathlon at the 1948 Winter Olympics ended in St. Moritz.
records.textJa: 1948年2月4日、winter pentathlon at the 1948 Winter Olympicsが終わった（St. Moritz）。
